description: All mixed interventions in Aviado's evidence graph that move a biomarker, each labelled with intervention_type: supplement, food_substance, prescription_drug, research_compound, research_nootropic, medical_compound, form_dependent, not_recommendable or unknown (omitted on plain recommendable supplement rows; see coverage.row_defaults). Rows that are not supplements are context, never a recommendation, and carry no dose or pathway details. Rows carry up to 3 PubMed IDs (pmids; URL template in coverage); optional direction (up/down) filters. graph_status (proven/suspected) is an internal eligibility label, not clinical validation; pathway_tags are raw graph metadata, not validated mechanisms. Coverage is partial and non-exhaustive; absence is not evidence of no effect (see coverage). The biomarker may be a name, an abbreviation, an Aviado id or a LOINC code (e.g. '4548-4'). Check status first: needs_confirmation / no_match means the input did not resolve, data is null and next_step says how to retry.

biomarker.description: Biomarker name, abbreviation, or LOINC code

direction.description: Only rows whose strongest edge moves the biomarker this way ('down' lowers it, 'up' raises it); bidirectional rows match neither

name: get_interventions_for_biomarker
title: All interventions for a biomarker
